entities.title: The tests
entities.summary: Node's test runner over worker/app.js, with GitHub faked, and over the pure block of index.html that reads and writes Cyberspace's addresses.
entities.purpose: Checks the Worker's routes, sign-in and door to GitHub without a network or a Cloudflare account, and Cyberspace's addresses without a browser.
boundaries: Tests the Worker, and of index.html only the block between /* space-world:start */ and /* space-world:end */, run in node:vm; nothing here drives a browser.
GitHub is a fake fetch; the secrets are test values.
